notes.title: Release Date + Tiny Teams
notes.content: [h3]Coming [b]SEPTEMBER 9th, 2025[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that [b]Heroes of the Seven Islands[/b] officially has a release date![/p][p]The game is expected to take players roughly [u]10-15 hours[/u] on their first playthrough. It will be listed for [u]$11.99 USD[/u] with a planned launch discount.[/p][previewyoutube="4Skrsq2USqg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Check out this brand new trailer made to celebrate the occasion, featuring an all new theme for the game composed by the incredibly talented Eric Shumaker ([i]Look Outside[/i]).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096725/fc903b31bc6f5c343f5d8f95d23b6c4a9db8c5ff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are also incredibly excited to have [b]Heroes of the Seven Islands [/b]selected to take part in the [u]Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival 2025[/u]! This event is dedicated to small indie game teams. Be sure to check it out to support other solo/small teams and their delightful games![/p][p]Be sure to add Heroes of the Seven Islands to your Wishlist. You can try the free demo NOW. And be sure to leave us a review so we can polish the game leading up to the release next month![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346810/Heroes_of_the_Seven_Islands_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
